name: SDAT
subtitle: Personal iPhone TIDAL player
description: Unsigned builds of SDAT, a SwiftUI TIDAL player for iOS 26 with Liquid Glass, powered by the tonearm-rs Rust core. Built by GitHub Actions from https://github.com/Nichokas/SDAT.

apps.subtitle: TIDAL player with Liquid Glass

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's Changed
* feat(android): background playback with a Media3 session, notification and headset controls by @Nichokas in https://github.com/Nichokas/SDAT/pull/73
* Report the Listen Together guest list once per change by @Nichokas in https://github.com/Nichokas/SDAT/pull/87
* Smooth the iOS bottom-bar morph and cut per-frame work by @Nichokas in https://github.com/Nichokas/SDAT/pull/88
* Keep Android per-frame animation out of composition by @Nichokas in https://github.com/Nichokas/SDAT/pull/93
* fix(live): remove standing offsets and wrong-position playback in Listen Together by @Nichokas in https://github.com/Nichokas/SDAT/pull/92
* feat(android): per-tab back stacks, large-title pages, the bottom-chrome morph and toasts by @Nichokas in https://github.com/Nichokas/SDAT/pull/91
* Add a manual Release workflow for desktop and iOS by @Nichokas in https://github.com/Nichokas/SDAT/pull/97
* Port the iOS player sheet, queue and playback persistence to Android by @Nichokas in https://github.com/Nichokas/SDAT/pull/95
* Port the iOS boot loader and Discover pool cache to Android by @Nichokas in https://github.com/Nichokas/SDAT/pull/102
* Let Release bump each platform's version on its own by @Nichokas in https://github.com/Nichokas/SDAT/pull/101


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Nichokas/SDAT/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0

Changes since 1.2.2:
- Listen Together sync fixes (#32): guests no longer start a new track at the previous track's position, guest start is aligned with the host's position, and host seeks reach guests faster

Unsigned build: sideload with your own signing tool.

Changes since 1.1.0:
- Listen Together: guests can control playback when the host allows it
- Listen Together: the Queue button works again
- Listen Together: guests no longer get stuck in a seek loop that silenced audio
- Listen Together: more stable guest playback, and sync never changes the playback speed
- The audio session is released when idle so iOS can suspend the app

Unsigned build: sideload with your own signing tool.

Changes since 1.0.0:
- Renamed to SDAT (new bundle id `com.nichokas.SDAT`, so it installs as a separate app from Torneam)
- Redesigned login and a boot loader that shows real warm-up progress
- Offline downloads: Downloads screen, download status ring, download option in "…" menus
- Highest-quality downloads and an offline playback indicator
- Offline album pages and local-first covers
- Background downloads with system progress (BGContinuedProcessingTask); interrupted queues resume on next launch
- Discover: long-press context menu on cover tiles
- Faster collapse/expand animations; miniplayer hold threshold 0.12 s
- New transparent reel app icon

Unsigned build: sideload with your own signing tool.

First release.
- TIDAL playback via the tonearm-rs Rust core
- Liquid Glass UI with morphing tab bar and circular miniplayer
- Discover with infinite queue
- Queue editing, repeat and shuffle
- Lock screen controls with favorite
- Playback resume after relaunch
- Call/interruption handling
